newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen up on more foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen up on more foreign buying.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to consolidate on 4.84 percent gains posted on Thursday as foreigners were seen buying more key blue chips, analysts said.
The SET Index rose 23.99 points, or 4.84 percent, to 496.03 on Wednesday. The SET 50 rose 0.37 points to 35.27 in high volume trade.

Foreigners, attracted by Thai market trading at nearly a 60- percent discount to a year ago, are again expected to increase their exposure to more defensive plays in banks, telecommunications and energy stocks, analysts said.
